title: President Assents to Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill 2026
summary: Mandates fast-track courts and 3-month trial conclusion for exam paper leak cases.

blocks.content: Mandates fast-track courts and 3-month trial conclusion for exam paper leak cases.

items: Trial Timelines: Paper leak investigations must complete within 2 months; fast-track trials must conclude within 3 months of chargesheet.
Penalties: Paper leak individuals face 5 to 10 years imprisonment & ₹50 lakh fine; organised syndicates face 7 to 10 years jail & ₹10 crore fine.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Builds on Public Examinations Act 2024 covering NTA, UPSC, SSC, and RRB exams | MoS Personnel: Jitendra Singh.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Individual paper leak penalty (5–10 yrs, ₹50L fine) vs organised crime penalty (min 7 yrs, ₹10 crore fine).
